verses.pali: “Pañcannaṁ, bhikkhave, macchariyānaṁ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṁ vussati.
verses.english: “Mendicants, the spiritual life is lived to give up and cut out these five kinds of stinginess.
Stinginess with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and the teachings.

verses.pali: kulamacchariyassa … lābhamacchariyassa … vaṇṇamacchariyassa … dhammamacchariyassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṁ vussati.
Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ macchariyānaṁ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṁ vussatī”ti.
verses.english: The spiritual life is lived to give up and cut out these five kinds of stinginess.”
